M1.reason: The front/back (0.866) and left/right (0.936) overlaps clear 0.80, but top/below is 0.187, far under the line, so 2 is ruled out. In the top and below views the original's shaft bows gently and its hook is an angular, faceted claw. The reproduction's shaft is dead straight and its hook is a smooth round curve. In the front and back views the original's wide flared chisel ends show as a broad bow-tie, while the reproduction's ends are narrow knobs.

M2.reason: Length, width and height (43.1 x 9.7 x 2.7 against 43.4 x 9.8 x 2.7) are each within 1% of the original's.

M3.reason: The red shaft, a hooked claw at one end and a straight end at the other are all there in the right places, but two shapes are off. The original's straight end is a wide flat tapered chisel blade (left/right and front views); the reproduction's is a thin flared knob. The original's hook is a flattened, faceted blade with a split claw (clearly black and sharp in first person); the reproduction's is a round tube with a small, blunt claw. It also adds a grey collar between the hook and the red shaft in first person that the original does not have.

M4.reason: Measured mean colour difference is 26.6, over the 15 line (worst from below at 40.8 and from the back at 36.4). The original's metal ends are a light flat grey in the world model and near-black in first person. The reproduction's are a darker blue-grey in the world model and a mid blue-grey in first person. The reproduction's red is also darker and more saturated, with near-black streaks, especially from below.

M5.reason: The original's two-tone red banding along the shaft and its crisp facet shading on the claw are only roughly echoed. The reproduction has dark mottled patches on the red (top and front-left views), dark spots on the claw tip, and an extra grey ring at the hook in first person that the original lacks.

M6.reason: At game size it reads as a red crowbar, but in the first-person view, the one that matters most, the original's black, sharp, angular claw stands next to the reproduction's grey, smooth, candy-cane hook with a grey collar. A player who knows the original would see the difference at once. The light grey flat chisel end of the world model is likewise missing.

M7.reason: Same front, upright, same way round: in every view the hook and the straight end sit at the same ends as the original's, the hook bends the same way, and the model lies on its origin at the same place and scale.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors and nothing looks open, inside out or floating, but it uses 260 triangles against the original's 60. That is 4.3 times, over the allowed twice (120).

W1.reason: In the still first-person view the crowbar sits at the same place, angle and handedness as the original, with the hook up and facing left. Through all ten attack frames it follows the original's arc frame by frame (up off screen at 1, upright in the fist at 3, the swing down at 4 to 7, back at 9 and 10) and never leaves the hand.
